record.body:
## Rationale

Overview is the glance surface; burying progress, requirements, and next action in markdown forces reading. Structured blocks on Overview keep prose where it belongs (spec/design/decisions/evidence tabs).

## Counter-argument

Chips above the existing overview markdown would be a smaller change. That was rejected because the body would still dominate and recreate the "wall of text" complaint.

payload.alternatives: Chips above existing overview markdown; Split overview into multiple sub-routes
payload.choice: Overview tab is a structured dashboard (chips, progress, next action, requirements strip, wave summary); other tabs stay prose/matrix
